body:
Describes a brief bodily return and the relationship she feared would hurt Simon.

Recorded role and choices

In the March 2025 scene, Cynthia becomes embarrassed when Simon enters and explains that she died after a childhood confined by illness. She says the full moon gave her a physical form for the night they met, allowing an experience of love she had never known in life. Her account remains personal testimony. The passage does not establish a general resurrection rule or a later permanent return.
